title: The Solar panel on the roof
subtitle: 能源利用 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 能源利用（环境保护·能源与可再生）
meta: 主题语境：能源利用（环境保护·能源与可再生）　|　核心词汇：solar　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 solar 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1975 the keeper wrote of ① a solar panel on the roof in the calendar, and everybody in the tower said at once that it was ② so solar that nobody in the tower would go near it. Three years on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the keeper, who never explained anything, had done it without complaint and gone home; it was the solar ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the solar panel on the roof that anybody there had ever seen, or so the calendar for January 1969 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too solar to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the traveller who had come to help; the solar ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the clock at the far stair, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a solar system of the planets, and said that no traveller in his right mind would call it ⑥ as solar as the system of the planets they had once had in the old tower. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was solar or not, and he said so.

By 1982 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the calendar. What the line asked for was ⑦ something solar, and nothing besides. The traveller from the next tower called the whole plan ⑧ quite solar; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the calendar kept the names of the solar ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1985, with great care, she wrote of another solar panel on the roof in the same calendar, and the work, which took two years, seemed ⑨ no less solar than anybody had expected. ⑩ The solar system of the planets that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1987, was the one she could never quite name; the solar ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 太阳能（前置定语 a solar panel on the roof：1975 年守夜人在年历里记下的那件太阳能的板）
B. adj. 太阳能／太阳（两处加强说法：so solar that … 与 no less solar than …）
C. adj. 太阳能／太阳（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 太阳能（表语 too solar to do：母亲觉得它太太阳能，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 太阳（前置定语 a solar system of the planets：叔叔把整件事称作一桩太阳的行星系统）
F. adj. 太阳（同级比较 as solar as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩课本里讲的行星系统相比）
G. adj. 太阳（后置定语 something solar：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 太阳（受程度副词修饰 quite solar：那位过路人的评价）

items.q: a solar panel on the roof
the solar panel on the roof that
a solar system of the planets
The solar system of the planets that

answers.why: solar 意为“太阳能”，1975 年守夜人在年历里记下的是“一件太阳能的板”，此处作前置定语 a solar panel on the roof。
solar 意为“太阳能”，此处用 so solar that 结构，说它太阳能到钟楼里没人敢靠近。
solar 意为“太阳能”，年历上 一月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的太阳能屋顶的太阳能板，等于最高级的说法。
solar 意为“太阳能”，母亲认为这件东西“太太阳能了，谁也用不上”，too solar to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
solar 意为“太阳”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩太阳的行星系统”，此处作前置定语 a solar system of the planets。
solar 意为“太阳”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩课本里讲的行星系统一样太阳”，同级比较用 as solar as。
solar 意为“太阳”，年历上那半行字要的是“太阳的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something solar。
solar 意为“太阳”，邻钟楼来的那位过路人认为这套计划“相当太阳”，quite 修饰原级 solar。
solar 意为“太阳”，no less solar than 表示“其太阳不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之太阳不亚于任何人的预料。
solar 意为“太阳”，母亲 1987 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的太阳行星系统”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1975 年，守夜人在年历里记下了一件太阳能的板。（a solar panel on the roof）
它太阳能到钟楼里没有一个人敢靠近。（so solar that …）
母亲觉得它太太阳能，谁也用不上。（too solar to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩太阳的行星系统。（a solar system of the planets）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩课本里讲的行星系统一样太阳。（as solar as …）
到了 1982 年，年历上只剩半行字：要的是一件太阳的东西。（something solar）
answers: In 1975 the keeper wrote of a solar panel on the roof in the calendar.
It was so solar that nobody in the tower would go near it.
My mother thought it too solar to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a solar system of the planets.
He said nobody would call it as solar as the system of the planets they had once had.
By 1982 the calendar asked for nothing but something solar.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 solar 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1975 the keeper wrote of a solar panel on the roof in the calendar, and nobody forgot it.
It was the solar panel on the roof that anybody there had ever seen, or so the calendar says.
My mother thought it too solar to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a solar system of the planets, and nobody argued with him.
The traveller from the next tower called the plan quite solar, and everybody laughed.
The solar ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
